_regions.W: white plumage in light: crown dome, face, throat, breast, belly, tail
_regions.S: folded wing and tail top, white in shade
_regions.O: pale grey rim on the lit front edge (forehead, throat, breast) and the tail's underside, so white reads on a light terminal
_regions.G: grey rim on the shaded back, nape, tail edge and tail end
_regions.Y: sulphur-yellow crest, partly raised, curving back from behind the crown dome
_regions.K: beak, dark slate (grey-black, lifted off terminal black)
_regions.U: yellow wash on the undertail, one pixel inside the tail's underside rim
_regions.P: perch (branch); may be mapped to transparent
